name: Basilica of Santa Maria Novella
heritage: Italian national heritage; part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
type: museum; minor basilica; religious museum; museum of a public entity
text: Santa Maria Novella is a Dominican church in Florence. It is considered the most important Romano-Gothic church in Tuscany and is a World Heritage Site. Its construction started in 1290 and it took almost 200 years to be completed.
